name: @edgegamers/surftimer-core
description: SurfTimer for s2script: map-trigger and SharpTimer-format zones, tick-exact timing, records, replays, styles.

database.description: Named database connection (databases.json); SQLite by default.

max_prespeed.description: Max 2D speed when leaving a start zone (velocity is scaled down to this). 0 disables.

prespeed_cap_in_zone.description: Also cap speed every few ticks while inside a start zone (anti-prehop).

fake_zone_height.description: Height added above SharpTimer-format JSON zone corners (they are floor-level).

replays.description: Record runs and save the best one per track/style.

replay_bots.description: Replay bots to keep on the server (0 = none). Bot 1 plays the map WR; extra bots cycle bonus WRs.

replay_max_minutes.description: Stop recording (and do not save) runs longer than this.

replay_prerun_ticks.description: Ticks of start-zone movement kept before the timer starts (replay pre-strafe).

hide_players_default.description: Hide other players for new joiners (toggle with !hide).

announce_pb.description: Announce personal bests to everyone, not only world records.

map_tiers_file.description: Tier data under the plugin's file sandbox (SharpTimer remote_data format).

map_tiers_url.description: Download SharpTimer-format map tiers on load (off-thread) and cache them in map_tiers_file. Empty disables.
